item.title: Middle East Eye: Iran's IRGC says two tankers ablaze in Hormuz
item.description: Iran's IRGC says two tankers ablaze in Hormuz The IRGC reports that two tankers caught fire after colliding with naval mines in the Strait of Hormuz. In comments carried by Iran's Fars News Agency, the IRGC's navy said that one of the ships was a supertanker carrying over 2m barrels of crude oil, while the other was transporting liquefied natural gas. It added that both vessels, which it said were supported by US forces, had breached Iran's protocol for crossing the contested waterway.
